sourceRefs.locator: pp. 10–11, 18–21: Themistius’ audience, the negotiated peace, changing positions and unresolved legal, military, fiscal and geographical details

summary.de: Römischer Heermeister, der an den Friedensverhandlungen beteiligt war. Zu seinem Konsulatsantritt lobte Themistios den Friedensschluss.
summary.en: Roman commander involved in negotiations for peace. Themistius praised the agreement in a speech marking his consulship.
